review:
Max Win Machine is a Hacksaw Gaming slot stripped down to a single idea: the reels only show Lucky Seven and dead symbols, and a win is made when one, two or three Lucky Sevens land in a line from the leftmost reel. One Seven pays 1x, two pay 10x and three pay the 10,000x maximum win. There are no free spins, no wilds and no bonus round.

That makes it very high volatility (5 out of 5) with a 96.22% RTP, and Hacksaw also lists 94.28% and 92.20% versions. Try the free demo to understand the rhythm, because most spins pay nothing and the whole game is a wait for three Sevens. It suits players who want the simplest possible chase at a known max win, and it's a poor fit for anyone who likes features.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 92.20% RTP
Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
